_comment: Pre-supported x86 laptop/desktop hardware profiles for the Generator Studio. Each profile fills concrete build settings (gpu_driver, enable_wifi/bluetooth) so picking a machine yields a tuned image. The hardware scanner can also auto-pick one. Curated from Framework + best-sellers on Amazon/Best Buy/Costco/Walmart; extend freely.

profiles.label: ASUS VivoBook F512DA (Ryzen 7 3700U / Vega 10)
profiles.notes: Amazon ASUS laptop; integrated Radeon Vega 10; bundle a /home copy (no data SSD).

profiles.label: Framework Laptop 13 (AMD Ryzen 7040)
profiles.notes: Framework 13 AMD; Radeon 780M; MediaTek MT7922 Wi-Fi/BT; excellent mainline support.

profiles.label: Framework Laptop 13 (Intel Core Ultra / 13th gen)
profiles.notes: Framework 13 Intel; Iris Xe / Arc; Intel AX210 Wi-Fi/BT.

profiles.label: Framework Laptop 16 (AMD Ryzen 7040HS, optional RX 7700S)
profiles.notes: Framework 16 AMD; optional discrete Radeon RX 7700S expansion bay; MT7922.

profiles.label: Dell XPS 13 (Intel)
profiles.notes: Best Buy/Costco best-seller; Intel iGPU + AX211.

profiles.label: Lenovo ThinkPad E14 (Intel/AMD)
profiles.notes: Popular business laptop; pick intel/amd-free by the scan.

profiles.label: Apple MacBook (Intel, pre-Apple-Silicon)
